svg.text: CH-Francis "Canyon" vertical unit: parts and measurements
Section through the unit axis, not to scale · left: the parts · right: what is measured there, and in which tree

g.text: Thrust bearing · carries the rotor weight and the water thrust · 6 pads
ThrustBearingTemp pad 1 only, element A: alarm 80, trip 90 °C
Generator · stator winding, air gap (rotor to stator), air coolers
Guide bearings UGB, LGB, TGB · keep the shaft centred · 4 pads each
<b> = UGB, LGB or TGB · pad 1 only for DRWPA · X/Y probes: see section A–A
Shaft speed and keyphasor · a notch, seen once per turn
keyphasorIdx in every waveform block · Context/Speed_rpm
Cooling water · from the river, through coils in each oil pot and the air coolers
CoolingWaterFlow the total, element A: alarm below 56 L/s
Headcover and shaft seal · the lid over the runner
Spiral case, wicket gates, servomotors · set the flow
GovernorOilPressure accumulator, element A: trip below 48 bar
Draft tube · the vortex rope at part load shows here first
Governor HPU · pumps, accumulator, filter, sump: oil for the servomotors
CH sensor of the CH monitoring PLC · v1.0/CH/Fleet/DRWPA/CopperCanyon/<serial>/…
Blue + teal pair = one dual-element RTD on pad 1 (A to the customer, B to CH) · ⊗ water from the inlet valve, into the page
